title: Equipment
purpose: See every tank, freezer, supply dewar and temperature monitor your repository has registered, with its latest reading and level, next due date and open excursions, and open one to work with it.
summary: Every tank, freezer, supply dewar and temperature monitor your repository registered, with its latest reading and level, next due date and open excursions.

tasks.title: Find a piece of equipment
steps: Type part of the asset ID or name in [[Search]], or choose the [[Kind]] or [[Storage unit]], then select [[Apply]].
Select the asset ID to open the record.

tasks.title: Find tanks that need filling
steps: Open [[More filters]], tick [[Below the low level]] and select [[Apply]].

good_to_know: Retired equipment is hidden until you change [[Status]].
Latest reading ignores readings that were corrected or withdrawn.
Next due is the date your repository entered. The application never calculates it.
Critical marks your repository's own list. It changes no rule.

sections.title: What the page is for
paragraphs: The register of storage equipment. Each row is one piece of equipment, identified by its asset ID. Open a row to record service events, LN2 entries, readings and excursions, or to change its limits and status. OpenBGA Biorepository has no default limits, refill levels or service intervals and never works out a due date: every one of them is entered by your repository, and what the page shows is what was entered.
Retired equipment is hidden until you choose Retired or Any status. Equipment is never deleted.
Every role that can sign in to the workspace can read this list, including viewers.

Type in the search box to narrow the rows, use the filters beside it, and choose 25, 50 or 100 rows per page (the default is 25). Active filters appear as chips that you can remove one by one, and the sort and column choices are kept in the address, so a view can be shared. A filter value that is not valid shows no rows rather than all of them. Changing a filter returns you to the first page.

sections.title: Search, filters and sorting
paragraphs: Search matches part of the asset ID, name, serial number or location, ignoring capitals. The default sort is asset ID ascending. Sortable columns are Asset ID, Status, Name, Kind, Storage unit, Read at (newest first on the first click), Next due and Active excursions (largest first on the first click). Latest reading and Latest level cannot be sorted.

items.label: Kind
items.description: LN2 storage tank, Mechanical freezer or refrigerator, Temperature monitor or probe, LN2 supply dewar or Other equipment.

items.label: Status
items.description: In use (the default: in service and out of service, not retired), In service, Out of service, Retired or Any status.

items.label: Storage unit
items.description: Only the equipment that encloses the chosen storage unit.

items.label: Below the low level
items.description: Under the More control. Lists LN2 tanks and supply dewars in use whose latest recorded level is below the low level your repository set, measured in the same unit. A vessel with no low level set, or whose latest level is in a different unit, is never listed.

items.label: Asset ID
items.description: Opens the equipment record. Always shown.

items.label: Status
items.description: In service, Out of service or Retired.

items.label: Name
items.description: The equipment's name; Critical follows it when the equipment is on your repository's list of critical equipment.

items.label: Storage unit
items.description: The storage unit the tank or freezer encloses, linked to the unit; a dash when it has none.

items.label: Latest reading (°C)
items.description: The most recent temperature reading that is still effective (not replaced by a correction and not withdrawn), chosen by the time it was read, not the time it was entered.

items.label: Read at
items.description: When the latest reading was taken. Hidden until you show it with Columns.

items.label: Latest level
items.description: The most recent effective LN2 level with its unit, from a level check or from the level after a fill.

items.label: Next due
items.description: The earliest of the equipment's current next-due dates (see Maintenance due). A date your repository entered, not a calculation.

items.label: Active excursions
items.description: How many excursions are open or awaiting review. A number above zero links to those excursions.

items.label: New equipment
items.description: Opens the form that registers equipment. Shown to managers and administrators.

items.label: Export CSV
items.description: Downloads the rows that match the current search, filters and sort as a UTF-8 CSV file, with exact decimal values and times in the repository's time zone. Every role that can read the list can download it. Correct any invalid filters to enable the download. If more than 10,000 rows match, the page shows the row limit. Narrow the filters to export. Cells that a spreadsheet could read as a formula are prefixed with an apostrophe. Each download is recorded in the audit trail with who exported which selection and how many rows, never the file itself.

items.label: No equipment registered yet
items.description: Nothing has been registered. Managers and administrators see a New equipment button.

items.label: No rows match
items.description: The search or filters exclude everything. Remove a chip or clear the search; check the Status filter if you expect retired equipment.
